name: Yottsu No Aishikata
source:
Bienvenido a la Institución.
Welcome to the Institution.

You have been admitted to the mose exclusive boarding school in the country. As a new student, your goal seems simple: navigate the complex social hierarchies of academia.

But the hallways of this building have a persistent echo. There is something in the eyes of your companions that does not fit, a feeling that every step you take has already been walked by someone else. between classes and furtive encounters, you will begin to notice your perception fragmenting. 

[Translated from [url=https://yuepunk.itch.io/yottsu-no-aishikata]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Bienvenido a la Institución。
欢迎来到该机构。

你已被该国最高级的寄宿学校录取。作为一名新生，你的目标似乎很简单：驾驭学术界复杂的社会等级制度。

但这座大楼的走廊却一直有回声。同伴的眼里有一种不合时宜的感觉，感觉自己迈出的每一步都已经被别人走过了。在课堂和秘密遭遇之间，你会开始注意到你的感知支离破碎。

[译自[url=https://yuepunk.itch.io/yottsu-no-aishikata]Itch.io[/url]]
